summary: Scripted fixture review: the three paths follow the brief's purchase order and prices, and the unsupported rebounds, critical shots and allied transformation stay listed as unsupported mechanics.

findings.subject: path-2 tier 4
findings.message: The brief's Fan Club transforms up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys; the Unit keeps only its own frenzy.
findings.action: Decide whether an ally operator is worth a Definition extension.

omissionVerdicts.reason: Transforming nearby allied Units is the technique's central effect, and no typed change or proposed mechanic on a purchase affects another Unit; minor fits a brief that names it only at x-4-x and x-5-x.
A hit counter is the central effect, and damage or a proposed mechanic on x-4-x would carry only its size, not its every-tenth-shot timing; minor fits a brief that names it only on the bottom path.

thirdPurchaseVerdicts.reason: 3-x-x Spike-o-pult turns the top path's pierce into a heavy spiked ball with 13 more pierce and more damage; no other path's purchase reaches that pierce.
x-3-x Triple Shot is the only purchase that fires more than one projectile; x-1-x and x-2-x only attack faster.
x-x-3 Crossbow adds damage and pierce to a path whose first two purchases add range and Camo detection, and no other path gains range at its third purchase.

fifthPurchaseVerdicts.reason: 5-x-x Ultra-Juggernaut adds Split Balls, a follow-up that carries each hit to up to twelve other nearby enemies, which neither other fifth purchase buys, and it crowns the top path's heavy, high-pierce ball.

x-5-x Plasma Monkey Fan Club only doubles the frenzy's damage and lengthens it; beside 5-x-x's split and x-x-5's damage type its play reason is the allied transformation, an unsupported mechanic, so its capstone value waits on the Definition.
fifthPurchaseVerdicts.action: Give x-5-x a supported capability of the frenzy, such as a follow-up during the Active, or keep the allied transformation as a design gap.

fifthPurchaseVerdicts.reason: x-x-5 Crossbow Master is the only fifth purchase that switches to normal damage, so its bolts reach Lead, and its faster, harder bolts crown the bottom path's long-range precision.
